title: API: a mixed deactivate request fails already-inactive, core and unknown ids with reasons and null partNumber
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com, S2 shop. Location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. API replay from Chrome DevTools against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location (Copy as fetch from a request of the logged-in session, then edit method, path and body). Ids needed: QAPL-CAP-012 (active), QAPL-I2 (inactive), QAPL-C1's core (from the API) and a random UUID (e.g. crypto.randomUUID() in the DevTools console). After the test send PATCH with "status":"active" for QAPL-CAP-012.
custom_steps:
1. PATCH /api/inventory/parts/status with body {"partIds":["<QAPL-CAP-012 id>","<QAPL-I2 id>","<QAPL-C1 core id>","<random uuid>"],"status":"inactive"}.
  2. GET /api/inventory/parts?status=inactive&search=QAPL-CAP-012.
  3. Open QAPL-I2's Part History.
  4. Open /parts/history/<QAPL-C1 core id> and search QAPL-C1 on the Active tab.
custom_expected:
1. 200; data.updated holds only QAPL-CAP-012; data.failed holds QAPL-I2 with "Part is already in that state.", the core id with "A core follows its part. Activate or deactivate the part instead." and the random id with "Part not found." and partNumber: null.
  2. QAPL-CAP-012 is listed with is_active: false.
  3. No new entry was written by this request.
  4. The core has no new entry; QAPL-C1 is still on the Active tab.
